reviewed_scope: Complete new bootstrap and native extracted-function tests; existing research/trial launcher composition.
Exact four-source inventory, loaded-self hash, raw trial configuration binding, fixed practice identity and Friday cutoff.
Research-first startup, exact canonical process path and required supervisor switches, refusal on conflicting/duplicate supervisors, adoption of already running trial worker or watchdog.
Named bootstrap/child mutex composition and existing worker lock remain duplicate-prevention authority; repeated inspection before spawn is observational, not an atomic process transaction.
Read-only CheckOnly/Once paths have no child/status/mutex mutation; default writes its own bootstrap status and launches only the two existing hidden launchers.

After cutoff, bootstrap does not start research; existing trial worker independently enforces deadline and close-only behavior. No deadline extension, state reset, source/model edits or broker command added.
Windows shared-delete source reads allow existing atomic writers; post-read status clock check and between-loop rollback refusal reviewed.
limits: Source review only; no actual registration, launch, restart, broker request, process census or native test execution performed by reviewer.
The local source manifest is a local trust binding, not protection against an adversary controlling both source and manifest.
Process presence is not proof of fresh research outputs; existing forecast and broker/policy gates remain responsible for entry eligibility.
Logon startup requires a user logon; this does not establish pre-login boot service execution.
A crash after a successful read but before launch is not eliminated by inspection; underlying supervisor/watchdog mutex and account worker lock retain final exclusivity.
